summary.text: In July 2026, Malik described AI as one of the defining economic opportunities of our lifetime. In September 2026, Malik characterized the opportunity from AI and superintelligence as enormous while endorsing safe and responsible advancement of American innovation. Malik's March and June 2026 statements emphasized operationalizing AI, improving risk management and resilience, and maintaining effective governance in financial services.
